sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 482 x 205 x 133 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Klark Teknik DN360 operator manual (third-party host of the manufacturer manual), opened 2026-11-12: 482 x 205 x 133 mm (19 in x 8 in x 5.25 in, 3U), 5 kg net, dual-channel 30-band 1/3-octave graphic equaliser; terminations "Input 3 pin XLR" and "Output 3 pin XLR", transformer balanced; 3 pin IEC mains and a two-pole mains switch with LED on the front. The manual does not state the number of sockets: one input and one output per channel (2 + 2) is inferred from "dual channel", XLR genders by convention. Beta-modelled for that reason (portsDocumented false): no mains inlet and no controls are modelled either. The Canford page cited by the plan answered a bot challenge and was not opened. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
